name: Elephas: Best SaaS Black Friday Deals
accepts: SaaS tools, with a few Mac apps among them (Elephas, Fluent, Wins, PastePal on 20 Nov 2026). A blog roundup updated each year, run by the maker of Elephas.
cost_note: Neither the page nor the form states a cost.
how_to_submit: 'Want your deal listed? Submit it here' links to the Tally form https://tally.so/r/Eql1xL.
entry_format: Fields: product name, tagline, description (2 to 3 sentences), deal details, original price, discounted price, deal code, website or deal link, your email, valid until, logo (PNG or SVG), and a required link to your own BFCM roundup submission form.
rules: The last form field asks for a link to your own roundup submission form, which a single app maker does not have.
status_note: 61 deals with 2026 dates on 20 Nov 2026, 13 of them 'coming soon'. The page does not show which deals came through the form.
